comparison_axes.contour: Original character contours remain source-owned. Apple has a dark blue/purple rim and broad brush strokes; carrot and strawberry have outlined painted volume. Soup target is a rectangular full stove scene, not an isolated pot; movie has two nested ornamental screen frames. Flat arches/columns and Back/toast backing remain visible.
comparison_axes.material: Seven-room scene references and source hashes are bound. Ingredients use three different stroke/edge densities beside the softer kitchen. The stove target literally repeats nearby kitchen material at a different scale; it needs an isolated-source reuse trial. Movie and sleepover mix painted props with large flat filled room architecture. Raster extension does not establish style acceptance.
comparison_axes.palette: Kitchen cream/teal/gold is preserved by the existing stove source, but saturated red/purple-rim fruit stands out. Rumi turquoise/purple, Daddy rainbow/navy and Eagle pastel/black contours retain approved identity; palette variation alone is not a redesign justification.
comparison_axes.light: Existing highlights remain unaltered. Ingredient/stove/character targets have no added scene-contact treatment. The stove repeats its own lighting and wall shadow over the player; this is a staging/reuse problem rather than a license to relight originals.
comparison_axes.perspective: The target stove presents a second miniature view of the same kitchen, floating in front of the authored stove. Screen target is frontal like the room screen, but nested scale and duplicate frame break scene hierarchy. Bedtime cutouts remain standing/swimming front poses, not lying in the beds.
comparison_axes.scale: Find targets220x330/235x300/230x350, ingredient116x116, stove280x260, movie390x300 and bedtime155x230 are declared logical source rectangles; pulse and viewport transforms change measured native bounds. Full desktop snapshots show duplicate Eagle and Roshan at different scales. Wide aspect preserves1280 room art with dark margins. No phone squint/performance acceptance.
comparison_axes.contact: Original touch controls advance optional state directly while player remains at its room-entry foot. Tucking removes each cutout, with no sampled laid-down/tucked body or blanket contact. Existing hidden friend/companion and overlay are distinct consumers; do not discard approved identity art to fix staging.
comparison_axes.occlusion: The full stove target obscures Roshan and rainbow companion. Movie target covers the large screen and Roshan head. Entry/toast/instruction panels cover lower bodies and floors. Sleepover has4 cutout targets plus the live Roshan and companion, creating duplicate identity/overlap. No full compositor closure is claimed from the bounded node inventory.
comparison_axes.readability: Original controls work and source voice/text calls exist, but movie messages narrate a dancing crab, clouds and family hug while the captured screen texture remains blank. Text is not proof that action was shown. Ingredient identities are recognizable to this reviewer, not child/device accepted.
comparison_axes.action_state: Source hunt,3 ingredients+stir,3 movie counts and4 bedtime taps complete through original controls.88 checks bind passive/mid/final same-engine reload/repeat and reward flags, not actual acting or full82/QA11/device/child/owner acceptance. Discrete snapshots cannot accept full motion, contact transitions or OS restart.
